The characteristic polynomial is given by $p(\lambda) = \det(\lambda I - A)$.

First, let's write out the matrix $\lambda I - A$:
$$
\lambda I - A = \begin{pmatrix} 
\lambda - \frac{189}{16} & \frac{27}{4} & -\frac{83}{8} \\ 
-\frac{39}{8} & \lambda + \frac{43}{8} & \frac{41}{16} \\ 
-\frac{21}{16} & -\frac{213}{16} & \lambda - \frac{35}{8}

$$
To simplify the computation, we can factor out $\frac{1}{16}$ from each row. This gives us a scalar factor of $(\frac{1}{16})^3 = \frac{1}{4096}$ multiplied by the determinant of a matrix with integer entries:
$$
p(\lambda) = \frac{1}{4096} \det \begin{pmatrix} 
16\lambda - 189 & 108 & -166 \\ 
-78 & 16\lambda + 86 & 41 \\ 
-21 & -213 & 16\lambda - 70 
\end{pmatrix}
$$
Let $M$ be the $3 \times 3$ integer matrix above. We can compute its determinant by expanding along the first row:
$$
\det(M) = (16\lambda - 189) \det \begin{pmatrix} 16\lambda + 86 & 41 \\ -213 & 16\lambda - 70 \end{pmatrix} - 108 \det \begin{pmatrix} -78 & 41 \\ -21 & 16\lambda - 70 \end{pmatrix} - 166 \det \begin{pmatrix} -78 & 16\lambda + 86 \\ -21 & -213 \end{pmatrix}
$$

Substitute these back into the expansion of $\det(M)$:
$$

$$
\det(M) = 4096\lambda^3 - 44288\lambda^2 + 74032\lambda - 4253145
$$
